tasks.title: Conversation #97
tasks.transcript:
Man: I need to buy birthday gift for my sister. She loves reading, but I'm not sure which book to get her.
Woman: Why don't you get her the latest mystery novel? She's really into that genre.
Man: That's a great idea. Do you know of any popular titles right now?
Woman: Yes, the Silent Witness is getting rave reviews. She might enjoy that.
Man: Perfect. I'll get that one.

questions.stem: What is the man looking for?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：男士在寻找什么？ 定位原文：Man: I need to buy a birthday gift for my sister. She loves reading, but I'm not sure which book to get her. 选项分析： A. A birthday card 生日卡片。对话中未提及卡片，所以A选项错误。 B. A book 一本书。男士明确说要给喜欢阅读的妹妹买书作为生日礼物，所以B选项正确。 C. A movie 一部电影。对话中未提及电影，所以C选项错误。 D. A game 一款游戏。对话中未提及游戏，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What genre does the woman suggest?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：女士建议了哪种类型的小说？ 定位原文：Woman: Why don't you get her the latest mystery novel? She's really into that genre. 选项分析： A. Romance 浪漫爱情小说。对话中未提及浪漫爱情类，所以A选项错误。 B. Science fiction 科幻小说。对话中未提及科幻类，所以B选项错误。 C. Mystery 悬疑推理小说。女士明确建议购买“mystery novel”（悬疑推理小说），所以C选项正确。 D. Historical fiction 历史小说。对话中未提及历史类，所以D选项错误。
